title: A Day at the Space Station

sentences.en: Welcome aboard the International Space Station!
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到国际空间站！

sentences.en: My name is Linda, and this is my third month in space.
sentences.zh: 我叫琳达，这是我在太空的第三个月。

sentences.en: Every morning, I wake up at six o'clock inside a small sleeping bag.
sentences.zh: 每天早上，我六点就在一个小睡袋里醒来。

sentences.en: There is no bed in space, because everything floats!
sentences.zh: 太空里没有床，因为所有东西都飘着！

sentences.en: After washing my face, I eat breakfast with my team.
sentences.zh: 洗完脸后，我和队友一起吃早餐。

sentences.en: Then we start our work: science experiments and fixing machines.
sentences.zh: 然后我们开始工作：做科学实验和修理机器。

sentences.en: In the evening, we watch the earth through the window.
sentences.zh: 傍晚，我们透过舷窗看地球。

sentences.en: It is blue, beautiful, and full of life.
sentences.zh: 它是蓝色的，美丽的，充满生机。

sentences.en: At nine o'clock, we go to sleep — good night from space!
sentences.zh: 九点，我们就寝——来自太空的晚安！

questions.q: How long has Linda been in space?
options: One month
Two months
Three months
Six months
questions.explain: 她明确说 "this is my third month in space"。

questions.q: Why is there no bed in the space station?
options: It is too expensive
Everything floats in space
The station is too small
Astronauts never sleep
questions.explain: 因为没有重力，所有东西都会漂浮，所以睡觉用固定在墙上的睡袋。

questions.q: What do they do in the evening?
options: Watch the earth through the window
Fix machines
Do experiments
Cook dinner
questions.explain: 傍晚他们的活动是 "watch the earth through the window"。

title: The Journey to Mars

sentences.en: The red planet has always fascinated humanity.
sentences.zh: 这颗红色星球一直让人类着迷。

sentences.en: A trip to Mars takes about eight months with today's rockets.
sentences.zh: 以今天的火箭技术，去火星大约需要八个月。

sentences.en: That is far longer than the three days it takes to reach the moon.
sentences.zh: 这比到达月球所需的三天要长得多。

sentences.en: The spacecraft must carry enough food, water, and oxygen for the whole crew.
sentences.zh: 航天器必须为全体乘员携带足够的食物、水和氧气。

sentences.en: Scientists are also testing how to grow plants on board.
sentences.zh: 科学家们还在测试如何在船上种植植物。

sentences.en: When the crew arrives, they will build a base and search for water under the surface.
sentences.zh: 乘员抵达后，他们将建立基地并寻找地表下的水。

sentences.en: If the mission succeeds, humans will become a two-planet species.
sentences.zh: 如果任务成功，人类将成为跨越两颗行星的物种。

questions.q: How long does a trip to Mars take with current rockets?
options: Three days
About three months
About eight months
Two years
questions.explain: 原文说 "about eight months with today's rockets"。

questions.q: Why are scientists testing how to grow plants on the spacecraft?
options: To make it look beautiful
To supply food on the long journey
To sell vegetables on Mars
To study colors
questions.explain: 长途旅行需要持续的食物供给，所以在船上种植物是关键实验。

questions.q: What will the crew do after arriving on Mars?
options: Return home immediately
Build a base and search for water
Fly to Jupiter
Study the moon
questions.explain: "they will build a base and search for water under the surface"。

title: The Signal from Deep Space

sentences.en: In 1977, a radio telescope in Ohio received a strange signal.
sentences.zh: 1977年，俄亥俄州的一台射电望远镜收到了一个奇怪的信号。

sentences.en: It lasted seventy-two seconds and came from the direction of Sagittarius.
sentences.zh: 它持续了72秒，来自人马座方向。

sentences.en: The astronomer Jerry Ehman circled the printout and wrote "Wow!" next to it.
sentences.zh: 天文学家杰里·埃曼在打印稿上圈了出来，并在旁边写下了"Wow!"。

sentences.en: That is why it became known as the "Wow! signal".
sentences.zh: 这就是它后来被称为"Wow!信号"的原因。

sentences.en: The signal was powerful and narrow-band, which is exactly what scientists expect from an artificial source.
sentences.zh: 这个信号强大且处于窄频带，这恰恰是科学家们预期的人工信号特征。

sentences.en: However, despite decades of searching, no one has ever detected it again.
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管搜寻了几十年，再没有人探测到过它。

sentences.en: Some researchers believe it was a natural reflection; others still hope it was a message from another civilization.
sentences.zh: 一些研究者认为那是自然反射；另一些人仍希望那是来自另一个文明的信息。

sentences.en: Until we hear it again, the Wow! signal remains one of the universe's greatest mysteries.
sentences.zh: 在再次听到它之前，Wow!信号仍是宇宙最大的谜团之一。

questions.q: When was the Wow! signal first detected?
questions.explain: 信号于1977年被俄亥俄州的射电望远镜捕捉。

questions.q: Why did the signal get its name?
options: The telescope was called Wow
Astronomer Jerry Ehman wrote "Wow!" on the printout
It sounded like someone saying wow
It arrived on WOW day
questions.explain: 埃曼在打印稿上写下"Wow!"，信号由此得名。

questions.q: What makes the signal interesting to scientists?
options: It repeated every night for a year
It was powerful and narrow-band like an artificial source
It contained a clear voice message
It came from the moon
questions.explain: 强大且窄频带——正是人工信号应有的特征，但此后再未重现。

title: The Moon: Our Nearest Neighbor

sentences.en: The moon is the closest neighbor of the earth.
sentences.zh: 月球是地球最近的邻居。

sentences.en: It is about 384,000 kilometers away from us.
sentences.zh: 它距离我们大约38.4万公里。

sentences.en: The moon has no air and no water, so its sky is always black.
sentences.zh: 月球上没有空气也没有水，所以它的天空永远是黑色的。

sentences.en: In 1969, Neil Armstrong became the first person to walk on the moon.
sentences.zh: 1969年，尼尔·阿姆斯特朗成为第一个在月球上行走的人。

sentences.en: He said, "That's one small step for man, one giant leap for mankind."
sentences.zh: 他说："这是个人的一小步，却是人类的一大步。"

sentences.en: Today, scientists want to build a base on the moon.
sentences.zh: 如今，科学家们想在月球上建一个基地。

sentences.en: From there, rockets could fly to even farther worlds.
sentences.zh: 从那里，火箭可以飞向更遥远的世界。

questions.q: Why is the moon's sky always black?
options: Because it is always night
Because there is no air on the moon
Because it is too far from the sun
Because of black clouds
questions.explain: 没有空气就没有散射，天空呈现黑色——这与地球蓝色天空的原因正好相反。

questions.q: Who first walked on the moon?
options: Yuri Gagarin
Buzz Aldrin
Neil Armstrong
Michael Collins
questions.explain: 1969年阿波罗11号任务中阿姆斯特朗第一个踏上月球。

questions.q: Why do scientists want a moon base?
options: To live there forever
To launch rockets to farther worlds
To find water for drinking
To watch the earth
questions.explain: 文末说月球基地可以作为飞向更远世界的中转站。

title: Life Aboard the Space Station

sentences.en: Living in orbit is unlike anything on earth.
sentences.zh: 在轨道上生活与地球上的任何体验都不同。

sentences.en: Astronauts float from module to module, held down by nothing at all.
sentences.zh: 宇航员在舱段之间漂浮，完全不需要任何支撑。

sentences.en: Water behaves strangely there: it forms floating spheres instead of falling drops.
sentences.zh: 水在那里表现奇特：形成漂浮的水球而不是下落的水滴。

sentences.en: Without gravity, muscles and bones weaken quickly, so astronauts must exercise two hours a day.
sentences.zh: 没有重力，肌肉和骨骼会迅速退化，因此宇航员每天必须锻炼两小时。

sentences.en: They strap themselves onto a treadmill with rubber bands to run in place.
sentences.zh: 他们用橡胶带把自己绑在跑步机上原地跑步。

sentences.en: Food comes in sealed pouches, and salt and pepper are used in liquid form to keep them from floating away.
sentences.zh: 食物装在密封袋里，盐和胡椒要以液体形式使用，以免飘走。

sentences.en: Despite all the difficulties, many astronauts say watching sixteen sunrises a day never gets old.
sentences.zh: 尽管困难重重，许多宇航员说一天看十六次日出永远不会腻。

questions.q: Why must astronauts exercise two hours a day?
options: To win space races
Because muscles and bones weaken without gravity
Because they eat too much
To pass the time
questions.explain: 失重环境下肌肉骨骼快速退化，锻炼是必要的对抗手段。

questions.q: How do astronauts run on a treadmill in space?
options: Normally, like on earth
Strapped down with rubber bands
They cannot run in space
By holding their breath
questions.explain: 他们需要用橡胶带固定身体，否则一用力就会飘走。

questions.q: Why are salt and pepper used in liquid form?
options: Liquids taste better
To keep the grains from floating away
Doctors require it
Solid salt is not allowed
questions.explain: 颗粒物会飘进设备或眼睛，液态调料更安全。

title: Interstellar Travel: Dream or Destiny?

sentences.en: The nearest star system, Alpha Centauri, lies about four light-years from earth.
sentences.zh: 离地球最近的恒星系统半人马座阿尔法星距离我们约四光年。

sentences.en: Four light-years does not sound far until you realize that our fastest probe, Voyager 1, would need over seventy thousand years to get there.
sentences.zh: 四光年听起来不远——直到你意识到，我们最快的探测器旅行者1号也需要七万多年才能抵达。

sentences.en: Clearly, conventional chemical rockets will never carry humans to other stars.
sentences.zh: 显然，传统化学火箭永远无法把人类送到其他恒星。

sentences.en: This is why engineers are investigating radical alternatives: light sails pushed by giant lasers, nuclear fusion engines, and even generation ships.
sentences.zh: 因此工程师们正在研究激进的替代方案：巨型激光推进的光帆、核聚变发动机，甚至世代飞船。

sentences.en: A light sail, for instance, could theoretically reach twenty percent of the speed of light.
sentences.zh: 例如光帆，理论上可以达到光速的百分之二十。

sentences.en: At that pace, Alpha Centauri would be only about twenty years away.
sentences.zh: 以这样的速度，抵达半人马座阿尔法星只需大约二十年。

sentences.en: Whether such machines will be built within our lifetime remains uncertain, but the physics itself does not forbid the journey.
sentences.zh: 这样的机器能否在我们有生之年造出来尚不确定，但物理定律本身并不禁止这趟旅程。

sentences.en: Perhaps the real question is not whether we can travel to the stars, but whether we are wise enough to deserve them.
sentences.zh: 或许真正的问题不是我们能否去恒星旅行，而是我们是否足够配得上它们。

questions.q: How long would Voyager 1 need to reach Alpha Centauri?
options: Four years
Twenty years
About seventy thousand years
One hundred years
questions.explain: 以现有速度，旅行者1号需要七万多年才能飞到四光年外。

questions.q: Why does the author mention light sails?
options: To show chemical rockets are the best
To give an example of a radical alternative
To prove star travel is impossible
To describe a failed project
questions.explain: 光帆、核聚变、世代飞船都是"radical alternatives"的实例。

questions.q: What does the author suggest at the end of the passage?
options: Star travel is physically impossible
Physics does not forbid the journey; the challenge is human wisdom
We should stop dreaming
Only robots can travel
questions.explain: 结尾句：真正的问题不是能不能，而是"是否足够智慧配得上"。

title: At the Space Café

sentences.en: Hi! Welcome to the Space Café.
sentences.zh: 嗨！欢迎光临太空咖啡馆。

sentences.en: What would you like to drink?
sentences.zh: 您想喝点什么？

sentences.en: I'd like a cup of moon tea, please.
sentences.zh: 请给我来一杯月球茶。

sentences.en: Sure! Anything to eat?
sentences.zh: 好的！还要吃点什么吗？

sentences.en: Yes, one cheese sandwich, please.
sentences.zh: 是的，来一个芝士三明治。

sentences.en: Here you are. Enjoy your meal!
sentences.zh: 给您。用餐愉快！

sentences.en: Thank you very much!
sentences.zh: 非常感谢！

questions.q: Which sentence do you say when a customer asks for moon tea?
options: Here you are.
What would you like?
Good night.
See you later.
questions.explain: 递上东西时用 "Here you are."（给您）。

title: Checking In at the Space Hotel

sentences.en: Good evening! Do you have a reservation?
sentences.zh: 晚上好！您有预订吗？

sentences.en: Yes, I booked a room with an earth view.
sentences.zh: 有的，我订了一间能看地球的房。

sentences.en: May I see your passport, please?
sentences.zh: 请出示一下您的护照好吗？

sentences.en: Here it is.
sentences.zh: 给您。

sentences.en: Thank you. Your room is on floor ten, next to the observation deck.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。您的房间在十层，观景台旁边。

sentences.en: Great! When is breakfast served?
sentences.zh: 太好了！早餐几点供应？

sentences.en: From six to nine, in the dining capsule.
sentences.zh: 六点到九点，在餐饮舱。

sentences.en: Perfect. Have a nice stay!
sentences.zh: 太棒了。祝您入住愉快！

questions.q: How do you politely ask to see someone's passport?
options: Give me your passport.
May I see your passport, please?
Passport now!
You passport is where?
questions.explain: "May I... , please?" 是最礼貌的请求句式。

title: First Contact Protocol

sentences.en: When our probe detected an unknown craft approaching the outer rim, the captain ordered a full diagnostic sweep.
sentences.zh: 当我们的探测器发现一艘未知飞船正接近外环时,舰长下令进行全面诊断扫描。

sentences.en: Officers assembled in the control room and awaited instructions from Earth command.
sentences.zh: 军官们聚集在控制室,等待地球指挥部的命令。

sentences.en: Standard protocol required us to transmit a greeting in every known language.
sentences.zh: 标准协议要求我们用所有已知语言传送问候。

sentences.en: However, the response came back in a pattern our linguistics team had never seen before.
sentences.zh: 然而,回应以我们语言学团队前所未见的模式传回。

sentences.en: It took the team three hours to decode the message, which turned out to be a request for water.
sentences.zh: 团队花了三小时才解码这条信息,结果发现是一份对水的请求。

sentences.en: The first officer suggested offering some of our recycled ice reserves as a gesture of goodwill.
sentences.zh: 副官建议,献出一些我们循环利用的冰储量作为善意姿态。

sentences.en: The alien craft accepted, then drifted slowly back into the dark.
sentences.zh: 外星飞船接受了,随后缓缓飘回黑暗中。

questions.q: Why did the captain order a full diagnostic sweep?
options: A probe had detected an unknown craft.
The probe was malfunctioning.
A meteor was approaching.
The crew was bored.
questions.explain: 首句直接交代:探测器发现一艘未知飞船接近外环。

questions.q: How did the alien response arrive?
options: In a known Earth language.
As a code, in an unfamiliar pattern.
Through radio silence.
As a written letter.
questions.explain: 回应以团队前所未见的模式传回,需要三小时解码。

questions.q: What did the alien request?
options: A meeting with the captain.
A piece of our technology.
Water.
A map of the galaxy.
questions.explain: 解码后发现是一份对水的请求。

title: Echoes of an Ancient Star Map

sentences.en: Deep in the archive vaults of the Akademia Observatory, an odd pattern was discovered etched into a 200-year-old brass plate.
sentences.zh: 在学院天文台档案库的深处,人们在一块 200 年历史的黄铜板上发现了一个奇怪的图案。

sentences.en: The archive team, led by Dr. Vega, suspected it might be far older than the plate itself.
sentences.zh: 由维加博士领导的档案团队怀疑,这图案可能比铜板本身古老得多。

sentences.en: They sent the pattern through a network of astronomical databases worldwide.
sentences.zh: 他们把图案送进全球天文数据库网络比对。

sentences.en: To everyone's surprise, the pattern matched a cluster of star coordinates that did not exist when the plate was forged.
sentences.zh: 令所有人惊讶的是,图案与一簇在铜板锻造时还不存在的星体坐标完全吻合。

sentences.en: One possibility raised was that the engraver had transmitted a vision from a future generation.
sentences.zh: 有一种假设被提出:雕刻者可能传递了来自未来世代的某种幻象。

sentences.en: Another was that the plate had been deliberately forged as a hoax, although the motives were never clear.
sentences.zh: 另一种假设是铜板被有意伪造为骗局,虽然动机从未明朗。

sentences.en: Whatever the truth, the observatory now displays the brass plate at the entrance as their most intriguing exhibit.
sentences.zh: 无论真相如何,天文台如今在入口处陈列这块铜板,作为最引人入胜的展品。

questions.q: What was the odd pattern etched into?
options: An ancient star map.
A 200-year-old brass plate.
A glass lens.
A stone tablet.
questions.explain: 首句:在一块 200 年历史的黄铜板上发现的图案。

questions.q: Why was the discovery surprising?
options: The team had no interest in archaeology.
The pattern matched stars that didn't exist then.
The plate was made of gold.
The patterns were common.
questions.explain: 图案与铜板锻造时还不存在的星体坐标完全吻合。

questions.q: What is one explanation offered for the plate?
options: It was a future vision.
It was a weather report.
It was a dinner menu.
It was a child's drawing.
questions.explain: 维加博士团队提出过一种假设:雕刻者传递了来自未来世代的某种幻象。

title: A Conversation at the Cosmo Café

sentences.en: Welcome to the Cosmo Café, the only place on Station 9 where you can get a real cup of hot tea.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到宇宙咖啡馆,这是 9 号空间站上唯一能喝到真正热茶的地方。

sentences.en: Today's special is ginger tea with a hint of moon basil.
sentences.zh: 今日特饮是姜茶加一点月亮罗勒。

sentences.en: We are open from 06:00 to 22:00 station time every day.
sentences.zh: 我们每天 06:00 到 22:00(空间站时间)营业。

sentences.en: All drinks are served in zero-gravity-safe mugs, which you may keep as a souvenir for 12 credits.
sentences.zh: 所有饮品都用零重力安全杯盛装,你可以以 12 个积分留作纪念。

sentences.en: If you would like a private booth, please book one day in advance at the front desk.
sentences.zh: 如果你想订独立包间,请提前一天在前台预订。

sentences.en: We accept both credits and lunar rubies, but no Earth cash.
sentences.zh: 我们接受积分和月兔币,不收地球现金。

questions.q: What is the special drink today?
options: Moon coffee.
Ginger tea with moon basil.
Earth coffee.
Lunar latte.
questions.explain: Today's special is ginger tea with a hint of moon basil(姜茶加一点月亮罗勒)。

questions.q: How much does a souvenir mug cost?
options: 6 credits.
10 credits.
12 credits.
20 credits.
questions.explain: you may keep as a souvenir for 12 credits。

questions.q: When is a private booth booking required?
options: One day in advance.
One hour before.
On the spot.
One week in advance.
questions.explain: please book one day in advance at the front desk。

title: The Lighthouse on the Asteroid

sentences.en: Far from Earth, on an asteroid called Helios-7, stands the loneliest lighthouse in the solar system.
sentences.zh: 在远离地球、名为 Helios-7 的小行星上,矗立着太阳系中最孤独的灯塔。

sentences.en: It was built three centuries ago to warn freighters of the asteroid's hidden craters.
sentences.zh: 三百年前,人们修建它以警告货船避开小行星上隐藏的环形山。

sentences.en: Today, only a single keeper maintains the light.
sentences.zh: 如今,只有一位守塔人在维护这座灯塔。

sentences.en: His name is Anders, and he has lived there for twenty-two years.
sentences.zh: 他叫安德斯,已经在那里住了 22 年。

sentences.en: Each night, when the freighters pass, he watches their lights and counts them like stars.
sentences.zh: 每天夜里,当货船经过时,他数着那些灯光,像数星星一样。

sentences.en: He says the job is quiet, but he is never alone—the stars keep him company.
sentences.zh: 他说这份工作很安静,但他从不孤单——星星陪着他。

questions.q: Why was the lighthouse built?
options: To guide scientists to the asteroid.
To warn freighters of hidden craters.
To help visitors find a hotel.
To signal other lighthouses.
questions.explain: 三句:to warn freighters of the asteroid's hidden craters。

questions.q: How long has the keeper lived on the asteroid?
options: Two years.
Twelve years.
Twenty-two years.
Thirty years.
questions.explain: he has lived there for twenty-two years。

questions.q: What does the keeper compare the freighters' lights to?
options: Suns.
Stars.
Craters.
Fires.
questions.explain: he watches their lights and counts them like stars。

title: How Astronauts Sleep in Space

sentences.en: Sleeping in space is nothing like sleeping on Earth.
sentences.zh: 在太空里睡觉和在地球上完全不同。

sentences.en: Without gravity, astronauts must strap themselves into sleeping bags fixed to the wall.
sentences.zh: 没有重力,宇航员必须把自己绑在固定在墙上的睡袋里。

sentences.en: Each crew member has a small private cabin, no larger than a phone booth.
sentences.zh: 每位机组成员有一个不超过电话亭大小的小单间。

sentences.en: Most report that floating in a sleeping bag feels peaceful—until the first time you see a tool fly past your face.
sentences.zh: 大多数人报告说,飘在睡袋里感觉平静——直到你第一次看到一件工具从你脸旁飞过。

sentences.en: Because there is no up or down, the brain can become confused for the first week.
sentences.zh: 因为没有上下之分,大脑会在第一周产生混乱感。

sentences.en: After that, most astronauts learn to sleep in any position, including completely upside down.
sentences.zh: 之后,大多数宇航员学会在任何姿势下入睡,包括完全倒立。

questions.q: How do astronauts sleep without gravity?
options: They float freely.
They sleep standing up.
They strap into fixed sleeping bags.
They take special pills.
questions.explain: astronauts must strap themselves into sleeping bags fixed to the wall。

questions.q: What can confuse astronauts' brains in their first week?
options: The color of the walls.
The absence of up or down.
The taste of food.
The sound of fans.
questions.explain: the brain can become confused for the first week 因为没有上下之分。

questions.q: What do most astronauts eventually learn?
options: To sleep on a bed.
To sleep in any position.
To sleep only on their backs.
To sleep while running.
questions.explain: most astronauts learn to sleep in any position。

title: Why the Moon Has Phases

sentences.en: Every night the moon looks a little different.
sentences.zh: 每个夜晚,月亮看起来都有点不一样。

sentences.en: Sometimes it is full and round; other times only a thin curve shows.
sentences.zh: 有时它又圆又满;有时只露出一弯细细的月牙。

sentences.en: The moon does not produce its own light; it only reflects light from the sun.
sentences.zh: 月亮本身不发光;它只反射太阳光。

sentences.en: As the moon travels around Earth, we see different parts of its lit half.
sentences.zh: 随着月亮绕地球运转,我们看到它被照亮面的不同部分。

sentences.en: When the moon is between the sun and Earth, the lit side faces away from us, and we see a new moon.
sentences.zh: 当月亮在太阳和地球之间时,被照亮的一面背向我们,我们看到新月。

sentences.en: When Earth is between the sun and the moon, the lit side faces us fully, and we see a full moon.
sentences.zh: 当地球在太阳和月亮之间时,被照亮的一面完全朝向我们,我们看到满月。

questions.q: Why does the moon have phases?
options: The moon changes shape.
Earth's shadow covers it.
We see different parts of its lit half as it orbits Earth.
The sun is broken.
questions.explain: we see different parts of its lit half as the moon travels around Earth。

questions.q: When do we see a new moon?
options: When the moon is between the sun and Earth.
When Earth is between the sun and moon.
When the moon is far from Earth.
When the moon is bright.
questions.explain: When the moon is between the sun and Earth... a new moon。

questions.q: What kind of light does the moon give us?
options: Its own light.
Reflected sunlight.
Starlight.
No light at all.
questions.explain: it only reflects light from the sun。

title: The First Space Tourist

sentences.en: In 2001, an American businessman named Dennis Tito became the world's first space tourist.
sentences.zh: 2001 年,一位名叫 Dennis Tito 的美国商人成为世界首位太空游客。

sentences.en: He paid about twenty million dollars to spend eight days aboard the International Space Station.
sentences.zh: 他支付了大约两千万美元,在国际空间站上度过了八天。

sentences.en: At the time, many space agencies were against the idea of untrained people in orbit.
sentences.zh: 当时,许多航天机构都反对让未受训的人进入轨道。

sentences.en: They worried that a tourist might get in the way of important science.
sentences.zh: 他们担心游客会妨碍重要的科学工作。

sentences.en: But Tito's flight opened a new chapter, proving that ordinary people—given enough training and money—could visit space.
sentences.zh: 但 Tito 的飞行开启了新篇章,证明普通人——只要有足够训练和资金——也能去太空。

sentences.en: Today, several private companies offer short tourist flights, and the industry is growing fast.
sentences.zh: 如今,数家私人公司提供短期旅游飞行,这个行业正在快速发展。

questions.q: Who was the first space tourist?
options: Neil Armstrong.
Dennis Tito.
Yuri Gagarin.
Elon Musk.
questions.explain: an American businessman named Dennis Tito became the world's first space tourist。

questions.q: Why were space agencies worried about tourists?
options: They might spend too much money.
They might interfere with science.
They might be too kind.
They might be too lazy.
questions.explain: worried that a tourist might get in the way of important science。

questions.q: How much did Tito pay for his flight?
options: About two million dollars.
About twenty million dollars.
About fifty thousand dollars.
He paid nothing.
questions.explain: He paid about twenty million dollars。

title: Greetings from the Space Academy

sentences.en: Welcome to the Space Academy, where tomorrow's explorers train today.
sentences.zh: 欢迎来到太空学院,明日探险者的今日训练场。

sentences.en: Cadets arrive from all over the world, speaking many different languages.
sentences.zh: 学员们来自世界各地,说着很多不同的语言。

sentences.en: English is the official language, so all cadets take intensive English classes in their first year.
sentences.zh: 英语是官方语言,因此所有学员在第一年都参加密集的英语课。

sentences.en: Subjects include navigation, physics, robotics, and survival skills.
sentences.zh: 课程包括导航、物理、机器人和生存技能。

sentences.en: Cadets practice flight simulators for ten hours a week.
sentences.zh: 学员每周进行十小时的飞行模拟器训练。

sentences.en: After four years, they graduate as fully qualified space officers.
sentences.zh: 四年后,他们以完全合格的太空军官身份毕业。

questions.q: What is the official language of the Space Academy?
options: Spanish.
English.
Chinese.
French.
questions.explain: English is the official language。

questions.q: How many hours a week do cadets practice flight simulators?
options: Five.
Ten.
Twenty.
Two.
questions.explain: Cadets practice flight simulators for ten hours a week。

questions.q: How long is the Space Academy program?
options: One year.
Two years.
Four years.
Ten years.
questions.explain: After four years, they graduate as fully qualified space officers。

title: Reporting a Problem on Board

sentences.en: Excuse me, I have a small problem in my cabin.
sentences.zh: 打扰一下,我舱里有个小问题。

sentences.en: The air filter on the wall seems to be making a strange noise.
sentences.zh: 墙上的空气过滤器好像发出奇怪的声音。

sentences.en: It started about half an hour ago, right after dinner.
sentences.zh: 大约半小时前开始的,刚吃完晚饭之后。

sentences.en: I'm not sure if it's dangerous, but I thought I should report it.
sentences.zh: 我不确定危不危险,但我想应该报备一下。

sentences.en: Could someone from maintenance come and take a look, please?
sentences.zh: 能请一位维修人员过来看一下吗?

questions.q: Where is the problem?
options: In the dining hall.
In the cabin.
In the engine room.
In the garden.
questions.explain: I have a small problem in my cabin。

title: Ordering at the Lunar Diner

sentences.en: Hi there! What can I get for you today?
sentences.zh: 嗨!今天想吃点什么?

sentences.en: I'll have the moonburger with extra cheese, please.
sentences.zh: 我想要一份月亮汉堡,加多点奶酪。

sentences.en: Would you like fries with that?
sentences.zh: 要配薯条吗?

sentences.en: Yes, please. And a small lunar lemonade.
sentences.zh: 好的,再来一杯小杯的月兔柠檬水。

sentences.en: For here or to go?
sentences.zh: 堂食还是外带?

sentences.en: For here, thanks.
sentences.zh: 堂食,谢谢。

sentences.en: That'll be 18 credits. Your number is 23.
sentences.zh: 一共 18 个积分。您的取餐号是 23。

questions.q: What is the main course?
options: A moonburger with extra cheese.
A plain salad.
A small lemonade.
A bowl of noodles.
questions.explain: I'll have the moonburger with extra cheese, please。

title: A Sunday Morning at the Market

sentences.en: My name is Li Mei, and I am twelve years old.
sentences.zh: 我叫李梅，今年十二岁。

sentences.en: I live in a small town near a wide, slow river.
sentences.zh: 我住在一条宽阔舒缓的河边小镇上。

sentences.en: Sunday is my favorite day of the week.
sentences.zh: 星期日是我一周中最喜欢的日子。

sentences.en: On Sunday morning, I always go to the market with my grandmother.
sentences.zh: 每个星期日早上，我总是和奶奶一起去市场。

sentences.en: We get up early, before the sun is hot.
sentences.zh: 我们起得很早，趁太阳还没变热。

sentences.en: Grandmother wakes me at six o'clock with a gentle knock on my door.
sentences.zh: 六点钟，奶奶轻轻敲我的房门叫醒我。

sentences.en: "The best vegetables sell out early," she always says with a smile.
sentences.zh: "最好的菜很早就卖完了。"她总是笑着说。

sentences.en: First, we eat a quick breakfast of eggs and warm rice.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们快速吃一顿鸡蛋加热米饭的早餐。

sentences.en: Then we walk together to the bus stop at the end of our street.
sentences.zh: 然后我们一起走到街尾的公交车站。

sentences.en: The bus is our transport to the town market.
sentences.zh: 公交车是我们去镇上市场的交通工具。

sentences.en: The ride takes about twenty minutes.
sentences.zh: 车程大约二十分钟。

sentences.en: From the window, I watch green fields run past like a slow film.
sentences.zh: 透过车窗，我看着绿色的田野像慢电影一样掠过。

sentences.en: Farmers are already working in the morning light.
sentences.zh: 农民们已经在晨光里劳作了。

sentences.en: The market is loud and full of life.
sentences.zh: 市场喧闹而充满生机。

sentences.en: It is a rainbow of colors and a sea of sounds.
sentences.zh: 它是色彩的彩虹，也是声音的海洋。

sentences.en: "Fresh fish! Fresh fish this morning!" a seller calls across the square.
sentences.zh: "鲜鱼！今早的鲜鱼！"一个摊贩隔着广场吆喝。

sentences.en: Red apples sit in tall, shining piles.
sentences.zh: 红苹果堆成亮闪闪的小山。

sentences.en: Green vegetables stand in buckets of cool water.
sentences.zh: 绿色蔬菜立在一桶桶凉水里。

sentences.en: Grandmother knows every good seller in the market by name.
sentences.zh: 奶奶叫得出市场里每个好摊贩的名字。

sentences.en: She stops at Mr. Chen's fruit stand first.
sentences.zh: 她先在陈先生的水果摊前停下。

sentences.en: "Good morning, Auntie Li!" says Mr. Chen with a wide smile.
sentences.zh: "李奶奶早上好！"陈先生咧嘴笑着说。

sentences.en: He cuts a small piece of mango for me to try.
sentences.zh: 他切了一小块芒果给我尝。

sentences.en: It tastes sweet, like yellow sunshine.
sentences.zh: 它尝起来很甜，像黄色的阳光。

sentences.en: "Two kilos, please," says my grandmother.
sentences.zh: "请来两公斤。"我奶奶说。

sentences.en: Mr. Chen puts the mangoes into a strong paper bag.
sentences.zh: 陈先生把芒果装进一个结实的纸袋。

sentences.en: He tells us that some of his fruit is imported from the warm south.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我们，他的一部分水果是从温暖的南方进口来的。

sentences.en: "It travels three days by truck to reach this little town," he says.
sentences.zh: "这些水果要坐三天卡车才能到这个小镇。"他说。

sentences.en: Next, we walk to the fish tables near the market gate.
sentences.zh: 接着，我们走向市场门口附近的鱼摊。

sentences.en: The fish are still cold and silver from the river.
sentences.zh: 鱼还是河里捞上来的，又凉又银亮。

sentences.en: "Look at this one," Grandmother says, pointing at a fat carp.
sentences.zh: "看这条。"奶奶指着一条肥鲤鱼说。

sentences.en: "Its eyes are clear, so it is fresh."
sentences.zh: "它的眼睛清亮，所以很新鲜。"

sentences.en: She turns the fish over and looks at it carefully.
sentences.zh: 她把鱼翻过来，仔细看了看。

sentences.en: "We will take this one home for lunch," she tells the seller.
sentences.zh: "这条我们带回家当午饭。"她对摊主说。

sentences.en: A porter moves past us with a huge box on his back.
sentences.zh: 一个搬运工背着一个大箱子从我们身边走过。

sentences.en: He walks slowly and carefully between the narrow tables.
sentences.zh: 他在窄窄的摊位之间缓慢而小心地走着。

sentences.en: Everyone moves out of his way with respect.
sentences.zh: 所有人都尊敬地给他让路。

sentences.en: He wears a small portable radio on his belt.
sentences.zh: 他腰上别着一台小便携收音机。

sentences.en: Soft music follows him like a quiet river through the market.
sentences.zh: 轻柔的音乐跟着他，像一条安静的小河穿过市场。

sentences.en: Grandmother buys fish, eggs, tofu, and a big bag of rice.
sentences.zh: 奶奶买了鱼、鸡蛋、豆腐和一大袋米。

sentences.en: She also buys a small bunch of yellow flowers for the kitchen table.
sentences.zh: 她还买了一小束黄花，准备摆在厨房桌上。

sentences.en: "A market without flowers is like soup without salt," she jokes.
sentences.zh: "没有花的市场就像没放盐的汤。"她打趣道。

sentences.en: The bags are too heavy for her small arms.
sentences.zh: 这些袋子对她瘦小的胳膊来说太重了。

sentences.en: So the kind porter carries them all the way to the bus stop.
sentences.zh: 于是好心的搬运工一路把袋子搬到了公交车站。

sentences.en: "Thank you so much," says Grandmother, pressing a coin into his hand.
sentences.zh: "太感谢你了。"奶奶说着，把一枚硬币塞进他手里。

sentences.en: On the ride home, I hold the bag of mangoes on my knees.
sentences.zh: 回家的路上，我把那袋芒果抱在膝盖上。

sentences.en: The bus rocks gently, like a boat on the slow river.
sentences.zh: 公交车轻轻地摇晃，像慢河上的一条小船。

sentences.en: At home, the whole kitchen smells of fish and spring onions.
sentences.zh: 到家后，整个厨房都是鱼和葱花的香味。

sentences.en: Grandmother cooks while I wash the vegetables.
sentences.zh: 奶奶做饭，我洗菜。

sentences.en: Steam rises from the pot like little white clouds.
sentences.zh: 蒸汽从锅里升起，像一朵朵小白云。

sentences.en: At noon, my parents and my little brother come home.
sentences.zh: 中午，爸爸妈妈和弟弟回家了。

sentences.en: We eat together around the big round table.
sentences.zh: 我们围坐在大圆桌旁一起吃饭。

sentences.en: Everyone says the fish is the best in town.
sentences.zh: 大家都说这是全镇最好吃的鱼。

sentences.en: Grandmother laughs and says the secret is a fresh market and an early bus.
sentences.zh: 奶奶笑着说，秘诀就是新鲜的市场加上早班车。

sentences.en: After lunch, I write in my diary about the morning.
sentences.zh: 午饭后，我在日记里写下这个上午。

sentences.en: I write about the colors, the songs, and the sweet smell of mango.
sentences.zh: 我写下那些颜色、那些歌声和芒果的甜香。

sentences.en: Ordinary days like this are the ones I remember best.
sentences.zh: 这样平凡的日子，恰恰是我记得最牢的。

questions.q: How do Li Mei and her grandmother travel to the market?
options: On foot.
By bus.
By truck.
By boat.
questions.explain: 第10句 "The bus is our transport to the town market"，公交车是他们的交通工具。

questions.q: How does Grandmother know that the fish is fresh?
options: Its eyes are clear.
Its color is silver.
Its price is low.
It smells of flowers.
questions.explain: "Its eyes are clear, so it is fresh" —— 眼睛清亮就说明鱼新鲜。

questions.q: Why does everyone move out of the porter's way?
options: Because he sings loudly.
Because he sells fish.
Because they respect his hard work.
Because he is angry.
questions.explain: "Everyone moves out of his way with respect" —— 出于对他辛勤劳动的尊敬。

questions.q: According to Grandmother, what is the secret of the best lunch?
options: Expensive imported fruit.
A fresh market and an early bus.
Yellow flowers on the table.
A kind porter.
questions.explain: 结尾奶奶笑答：秘诀是 "a fresh market and an early bus"。

title: The Honest Porter

sentences.en: Riverside Station is a small train station in the green hills.
sentences.zh: 河畔站是绿色群山间的一个小火车站。

sentences.en: Wang Shifu has worked there as a porter for thirty years.
sentences.zh: 王师傅在那里当了三十年的搬运工。

sentences.en: Every day, he transports travelers' heavy bags from the platform to the buses outside.
sentences.zh: 每天，他把旅客沉重的行李从站台搬到外面的公交车上。

sentences.en: He is old now, but his back is still as strong as a young tree.
sentences.zh: 他如今上了年纪，但脊背依然像小树一样结实。

sentences.en: All the travelers know him, and everybody in the town likes him.
sentences.zh: 旅客们都认识他，镇上的每个人也都喜欢他。

sentences.en: One cold evening in November, the last train left at nine o'clock.
sentences.zh: 十一月一个寒冷的夜晚，末班车九点钟开走了。

sentences.en: The station became quiet, and the long platform was almost empty.
sentences.zh: 车站安静下来，长长的站台上几乎空无一人。

sentences.en: Wang Shifu walked slowly along the platform with his lamp, as he always did.
sentences.zh: 王师傅像往常一样，提着灯沿着站台慢慢巡视。

sentences.en: Then he saw something strange on the long wooden bench.
sentences.zh: 这时他看见长木凳上有个奇怪的东西。

sentences.en: A black travel bag was sitting there all alone.
sentences.zh: 一只黑色旅行包孤零零地放在那里。

sentences.en: No traveler was anywhere near it.
sentences.zh: 附近一个旅客也没有。

sentences.en: Wang Shifu looked around, but he could see nobody.
sentences.zh: 王师傅环顾四周，但一个人影也没看到。

sentences.en: "Someone has lost this," he said quietly to himself.
sentences.zh: "这是有人丢了。"他轻声自言自语。

sentences.en: He picked up the bag with both hands.
sentences.zh: 他用双手拎起了那只包。

sentences.en: It was heavy, but he did not open it, because it was not his.
sentences.zh: 包很沉，但他没有打开，因为那不是他的东西。

sentences.en: Instead, he carried it straight to the station office.
sentences.zh: 他径直把包送到了车站办公室。

sentences.en: "Please report this lost bag," he told the young officer on duty.
sentences.zh: "请登记上报这只遗失的包。"他对值班的年轻站员说。

sentences.en: Together with the manager, they inspected the bag and wrote down everything.
sentences.zh: 他们和站长一起检查了包，并把每样东西记录在案。

sentences.en: Inside the bag, they found three things.
sentences.zh: 包里共有三样东西。

sentences.en: First, there was a thick envelope full of money.
sentences.zh: 第一样，是一只装满钱的厚信封。

sentences.en: Second, there was a photograph of a young woman holding a small child.
sentences.zh: 第二样，是一张年轻女子抱着小孩的照片。

sentences.en: Third, there was a train ticket to a city far away in the south.
sentences.zh: 第三样，是一张开往南方遥远城市的火车票。

sentences.en: The office manager recorded every detail in his big black book.
sentences.zh: 站长把每个细节都记在了他那本黑色大登记簿里。

sentences.en: "The owner will come back for it," he said.
sentences.zh: "失主会回来找的。"他说。

sentences.en: "Money like this must be very important to somebody."
sentences.zh: "这样一笔钱，对某个人来说一定非常重要。"

sentences.en: Wang Shifu went home, but he did not sleep well that night.
sentences.zh: 王师傅回了家，但那晚睡得并不安稳。

sentences.en: He kept thinking about the person who had lost the bag.
sentences.zh: 他一直在想那个丢包的人。

sentences.en: The next morning, he arrived at the station two hours earlier than usual.
sentences.zh: 第二天一早，他比平时提前两个小时到了车站。

sentences.en: At eight o'clock, a young woman ran into the station.
sentences.zh: 八点钟，一个年轻女子跑进了车站。

sentences.en: Her face was white, and her eyes were red from crying.
sentences.zh: 她脸色发白，眼睛哭得通红。

sentences.en: "My bag! I lost my black bag on the bench!" she cried.
sentences.zh: "我的包！我的黑包丢在长凳上了！"她喊道。

sentences.en: "My little son is sick in the south, and that money is for his hospital!"
sentences.zh: "我的小儿子在南方生病了，那笔钱是给他住院用的！"

sentences.en: The office manager stood up and asked her to sit down.
sentences.zh: 站长站起身，请她坐下。

sentences.en: "Please describe your bag for me," he said gently.
sentences.zh: "请描述一下您的包。"他温和地说。

sentences.en: "It is black, with a small red flower on the side," she answered.
sentences.zh: "是黑色的，侧面有一朵小红花。"她答道。

sentences.en: "There is a photograph of me and my boy inside it."
sentences.zh: "里面还有一张我和我儿子的照片。"

sentences.en: Everything she said matched the record in the black book.
sentences.zh: 她说的每一项都与登记簿上的记录吻合。

sentences.en: The manager opened the safe and brought out the bag.
sentences.zh: 站长打开保险柜，取出了那只包。

sentences.en: The young woman took it with shaking hands.
sentences.zh: 年轻女子双手颤抖着接过包。

sentences.en: She counted the money quickly, and not one yuan was missing.
sentences.zh: 她迅速点了点钱，一分都没少。

sentences.en: Then she turned to Wang Shifu, who was standing quietly by the door.
sentences.zh: 然后她转向安静站在门边的王师傅。

sentences.en: "Was it you, sir, who found my bag?" she asked.
sentences.zh: "先生，是您捡到了我的包吗？"她问。

sentences.en: "Yes, madam," the old porter answered with a small smile.
sentences.zh: "是我，女士。"老搬运工带着一丝微笑回答。

sentences.en: The woman pulled two hundred yuan from the envelope and held it out to him.
sentences.zh: 女子从信封里抽出两百元，递到他面前。

sentences.en: "Please take this," she said.
sentences.zh: "请收下这个。"她说。

sentences.en: "You have saved my son's life."
sentences.zh: "您救了我儿子的命。"

sentences.en: But Wang Shifu shook his head and softly pushed the money back.
sentences.zh: 但王师傅摇了摇头，轻轻把钱推了回去。

sentences.en: "Keep it for your boy," he said.
sentences.zh: "留给你孩子用吧。"他说。

sentences.en: "I only did what any honest person should do."
sentences.zh: "我只不过做了任何诚实的人都该做的事。"

sentences.en: The woman looked at him, and her eyes filled with warm tears.
sentences.zh: 女子望着他，眼里涌起了温暖的泪水。

sentences.en: The story traveled through the town faster than any train could.
sentences.zh: 这件事传遍小镇的速度比任何火车都快。

sentences.en: Soon people were calling him "the honest porter" with real respect.
sentences.zh: 很快，人们开始满怀敬意地称他为"诚实的搬运工"。

sentences.en: Wang Shifu still carries bags at Riverside Station today.
sentences.zh: 如今王师傅仍在河畔站搬运行李。

sentences.en: Travelers prefer his two strong arms more than any young man's back.
sentences.zh: 旅客们宁可要他两条结实的胳膊，也不愿找年轻人的脊背。

sentences.en: And he always says the same thing: "A good name is worth more than money."
sentences.zh: 他总说同一句话："好名声比金钱更珍贵。"

questions.q: What is Wang Shifu's job at Riverside Station?
options: Train driver.
Station porter.
Office manager.
Police officer.
questions.explain: 第2句 "he worked there as a porter for thirty years" —— 他是搬运工。

questions.q: What three things were found inside the lost bag?
options: Money, a photograph, and a train ticket.
Clothes, books, and shoes.
Food, a lamp, and a map.
A radio, keys, and coins.
questions.explain: 包里三样东西：厚厚的钱、年轻女子抱孩子的照片、一张去南方的火车票。

questions.q: Why did the young woman need the money so badly?
options: To buy a new travel bag.
To pay for her sick son's hospital.
To travel to Beijing.
To open a small shop.
questions.explain: "My little son is sick in the south, and that money is for his hospital"。

questions.q: What did Wang Shifu do when the woman offered him two hundred yuan?
options: He took it happily.
He asked for more.
He refused it and told her to keep it for her son.
He gave it to the office manager.
questions.explain: 他摇头把钱推回去说 "Keep it for your boy" —— 拒绝了酬谢。

questions.q: What does Wang Shifu mean by "A good name is worth more than money"?
options: Honesty and a good reputation are more valuable than wealth.
He wants to be paid in coins.
Names can be sold in the market.
Money is useless in small towns.
questions.explain: 全文主旨：他拒绝酬金、归还失物，说明在他心中好名声（诚实）比金钱更贵重。

title: The Case of the Missing Medals

sentences.en: Green Hill Middle School was always quiet at night, but the night before Sports Day was different.
sentences.zh: 绿丘中学的夜晚总是很安静，但运动会前夜却不同。

sentences.en: That night, something strange happened in the trophy room.
sentences.zh: 那天夜里，奖杯室里发生了一件怪事。

sentences.en: The next morning, Ms. Fang, the PE teacher, opened the glass case and stopped in surprise.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，体育老师方老师打开玻璃柜，惊讶地愣住了。

sentences.en: The three gold medals for the relay race were gone.
sentences.zh: 接力赛的三枚金牌不见了。

sentences.en: "This is a serious matter," she said.
sentences.zh: "这可是件严重的事。"她说。

sentences.en: "We must report it to the head teacher at once."
sentences.zh: "必须立刻报告校长。"

sentences.en: The school called an assembly, but nobody knew anything about the medals.
sentences.zh: 学校召开了全校大会，但没有人知道奖牌的下落。

sentences.en: That was when Lin Xiaoyu, a quiet girl from Class 2, decided to investigate.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，二班一个文静的女孩林晓雨决定着手调查。

sentences.en: Her classmates laughed at first.
sentences.zh: 同学们起初都笑话她。

sentences.en: "You read too many detective stories, Xiaoyu," they said.
sentences.zh: "晓雨，你侦探小说读太多了。"他们说。

sentences.en: But Xiaoyu only smiled, because she had a plan built on pure logic.
sentences.zh: 但晓雨只是笑笑，因为她有一个完全建立在逻辑之上的计划。

sentences.en: First, she inspected the trophy case carefully.
sentences.zh: 首先，她仔细检查了奖杯柜。

sentences.en: The lock was not broken, and the glass was not cracked.
sentences.zh: 锁没有被撬，玻璃也没有裂纹。

sentences.en: "So the case was opened with a key," she wrote in her notebook.
sentences.zh: "所以柜子是用钥匙打开的。"她在笔记本上写道。

sentences.en: Next, she examined the floor near the window with her small lamp.
sentences.zh: 接着，她用小台灯仔细查看窗户附近的地板。

sentences.en: There she found something small and interesting: a drop of candle wax.
sentences.zh: 在那里她发现了一个小而有趣的细节：一滴蜡烛油。

sentences.en: Then she found a second piece of evidence — a blue and white button, like the ones on the school team jackets.
sentences.zh: 然后她发现了第二件证据——一颗蓝白相间的纽扣，和校队队服上的纽扣一模一样。

sentences.en: Xiaoyu made a careful list of suspects.
sentences.zh: 晓雨列了一份嫌疑人名单。

sentences.en: Suspect number one was Mr. Hu, the old caretaker, because he had keys to every room.
sentences.zh: 头号嫌疑人是老管理员胡师傅，因为他有每间屋子的钥匙。

sentences.en: Suspect number two was Ma Qiang, the captain of the relay team, who had been seen near the room after school.
sentences.zh: 二号嫌疑人是接力队队长马强，有人看见他放学后在这间屋子附近出现过。

sentences.en: Suspect number three was Xiao Nan, the coach's daughter, who always cleaned the trophies on Fridays.
sentences.zh: 三号嫌疑人是教练的女儿小楠，她每周五都会擦拭奖杯。

sentences.en: The first suspect looked easy to accuse.
sentences.zh: 第一个嫌疑人看起来最容易指控。

sentences.en: Several students said, "It must be the caretaker."
sentences.zh: 几个同学说："肯定是管理员。"

sentences.en: But Xiaoyu rejected the idea quickly and politely.
sentences.zh: 但晓雨迅速而客气地否定了这个想法。

sentences.en: "Mr. Hu has worked here for twenty years, and everyone respects him," she said.
sentences.zh: "胡师傅在这里干了二十年，大家都敬重他。"她说。

sentences.en: "Besides, the footprints near the case are small, like a student's shoes."
sentences.zh: "再说，柜子旁边的脚印很小，像是学生穿的鞋。"

sentences.en: So she went to question Ma Qiang, the team captain.
sentences.zh: 于是她去找接力队队长马强问话。

sentences.en: Ma Qiang turned red and looked at the floor.
sentences.zh: 马强脸红了，低着头看着地板。

sentences.en: "I was near the trophy room, but only to return the key card I borrowed for practice," he said.
sentences.zh: "我确实在奖杯室附近，但只是去归还训练时借的门禁卡。"他说。

sentences.en: Then Xiaoyu noticed something important.
sentences.zh: 这时晓雨注意到一个重要的事实。

sentences.en: Nothing else in the room had been touched.
sentences.zh: 屋里其他东西一样都没动过。

sentences.en: The silver cups, the old shields, and even the money box for Sports Day were all perfectly safe.
sentences.zh: 银杯、老盾牌，连运动会的钱箱都安然无恙。

sentences.en: "A real thief takes whatever is valuable," Xiaoyu thought.
sentences.zh: "真正的贼是什么值钱拿什么。"晓雨想。

sentences.en: "So this was not a thief at all."
sentences.zh: "所以这根本不是偷窃。"

sentences.en: She began to consider a completely different explanation.
sentences.zh: 她开始考虑一种完全不同的解释。

sentences.en: On Friday evenings, someone always cleaned the trophies.
sentences.zh: 每周五傍晚，总会有人来擦拭奖杯。

sentences.en: Everyone knew it was Xiao Nan, because her father was too busy to do it himself.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道那是小楠，因为她父亲太忙，没空自己做。

sentences.en: Xiaoyu remembered the blue and white button and the small footprints.
sentences.zh: 晓雨想起了那颗蓝白纽扣和那串小脚印。

sentences.en: Xiao Nan wore the school team jacket, and her shoes were the smallest in her class.
sentences.zh: 小楠穿着校队队服，鞋码是班里最小的。

sentences.en: But why would the girl who cleaned the trophies take the medals?
sentences.zh: 可那个擦奖杯的女孩为什么要拿走奖牌呢？

sentences.en: Then Xiaoyu remembered the old red ribbon on the champion's trophy, which had been torn for weeks.
sentences.zh: 这时晓雨想起冠军奖杯上那条旧红绶带，它已经破了几个星期了。

sentences.en: "If I wanted to repair the ribbon before Sports Day," she thought, "I would take the medals home quietly."
sentences.zh: "如果我想在运动会前把绶带修好，我就会悄悄把奖牌带回家。"她想。

sentences.en: There was still one question: why hadn't Xiao Nan simply told someone?
sentences.zh: 还有一个疑问：小楠为什么不直接告诉别人呢？

sentences.en: Xiaoyu went to the trophy room one last time.
sentences.zh: 晓雨最后一走进了奖杯室。

sentences.en: She predicted that a nervous person might drop something small in a dark room.
sentences.zh: 她推测：一个紧张的人在黑暗的房间里很可能会掉落什么小东西。

sentences.en: So she lay down on the floor and looked under the heavy shelf with her lamp.
sentences.zh: 于是她趴在地板上，用灯照着沉重的架子底下看。

sentences.en: There it was: a folded note, almost hidden in the dust.
sentences.zh: 果然：一张折起来的纸条，几乎藏在灰尘里。

sentences.en: "Sports Day is tomorrow, so I am taking the medals home to fix the broken ribbon," the note said.
sentences.zh: 纸条上写着："明天就是运动会了，我要把奖牌带回家，修好那条破了的绶带。"

sentences.en: "Sorry! I will bring them back before eight o'clock. — Xiao Nan."
sentences.zh: "对不起！我八点前一定送回来。——小楠"

sentences.en: Xiaoyu smiled and put the note safely in her pocket.
sentences.zh: 晓雨微微一笑，把纸条妥帖地放进口袋。

sentences.en: The next morning, Xiao Nan returned the medals, shining and tied with bright new ribbons.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，小楠把奖牌送了回来，擦得锃亮，还系上了崭新的绶带。

sentences.en: When Ms. Fang heard the whole story, she laughed and shook her head.
sentences.zh: 方老师听完整个经过，笑着摇了摇头。

sentences.en: "You inspected, questioned, and thought before you judged," she said to Xiaoyu.
sentences.zh: "你先观察、先提问、先思考，然后才下判断。"她对晓雨说。

sentences.en: "That is exactly how we should treat every suspect: with logic and with respect."
sentences.zh: "对待每一个嫌疑人，都该这样：讲逻辑，也讲尊重。"

sentences.en: From that day on, everybody at Green Hill School called Xiaoyu "the little detective".
sentences.zh: 从那天起，绿丘中学的每个人都叫晓雨"小侦探"。

questions.q: What was missing from the trophy room?
options: The silver cups.
The money box.
The three relay gold medals.
The old shields.
questions.explain: "The three gold medals for the relay race were gone" —— 丢了三枚接力赛金牌。

questions.q: Why did Xiaoyu reject the idea that the caretaker was the thief?
options: He had worked there for twenty years, was respected, and the footprints were small like a student's.
He was too old to walk.
He had no keys at all.
He was away on holiday.
questions.explain: 晓雨的两条理由：胡师傅二十年深受敬重；柜边脚印很小，更像学生的鞋。

questions.q: What made Xiaoyu believe there had been no real thief?
options: Nothing else valuable in the room had been touched.
The lock was broken.
The window was left open.
A witness saw a stranger leave.
questions.explain: "A real thief takes whatever is valuable" —— 但银杯、盾牌、钱箱全都原封未动。

questions.q: Where did Xiaoyu find Xiao Nan's note?
options: In the money box.
Under the heavy shelf on the floor.
In Ma Qiang's pocket.
On the champion's trophy.
questions.explain: 她预测紧张的人会在黑暗中掉落东西，趴下一照，纸条就在架子底下的灰尘里。

questions.q: What lesson does Ms. Fang draw from the case?
options: Never trust students.
We should inspect, question, and think before judging.
Medals should be locked away forever.
Detective stories are dangerous for children.
questions.explain: 结尾点题："inspect, question, and think before you judge" —— 先观察提问思考，再下判断。

title: Marie Curie: The Woman Who Changed Science

sentences.en: In 1867, in the city of Warsaw, Poland, a girl named Maria Sklodowska was born.
sentences.zh: 1867年，在波兰华沙，一个名叫玛丽亚·斯克沃多夫斯卡的女孩出生了。

sentences.en: She would grow up to become Marie Curie, one of the greatest scientists in history.
sentences.zh: 她后来成为玛丽·居里，历史上最伟大的科学家之一。

sentences.en: Maria loved school more than anything else in the world.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚热爱上学，胜过世上一切。

sentences.en: But in those days, Poland was ruled by foreign powers, and women were not permitted to attend university there.
sentences.zh: 但在那个年代，波兰被列强统治，女性不被允许上大学。

sentences.en: So Maria made a secret plan with her older sister Bronya.
sentences.zh: 于是玛丽亚和姐姐布罗妮亚定下了一个秘密计划。

sentences.en: Maria would work for years to pay for Bronya's education in Paris.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚先打工多年，供布罗妮亚去巴黎读书。

sentences.en: Then, in return, Bronya would help Maria to study.
sentences.zh: 之后布罗妮亚再反过来帮助玛丽亚求学。

sentences.en: For six years, Maria worked as a governess in the countryside.
sentences.zh: 整整六年，玛丽亚在乡下当家庭教师。

sentences.en: She taught rich children during the day.
sentences.zh: 她白天教富人家的孩子。

sentences.en: At night, alone in her cold room, she studied chemistry and mathematics by candlelight.
sentences.zh: 夜里，她独自在寒冷的房间里就着烛光自学化学和数学。

sentences.en: In 1891, at the age of twenty-four, Maria finally boarded a train for Paris.
sentences.zh: 1891年，二十四岁的玛丽亚终于登上了开往巴黎的火车。

sentences.en: There she became a student at the Sorbonne, one of the most famous universities in the world.
sentences.zh: 在那里，她成为世界名校索邦大学的学生。

sentences.en: Life in Paris was harder than she had expected.
sentences.zh: 巴黎的生活比她预想的更艰难。

sentences.en: She lived in a tiny room on the top floor of an old building.
sentences.zh: 她住在老楼顶层的一个小房间里。

sentences.en: In winter, she was so cold that she wore every coat she owned to bed.
sentences.zh: 冬天冷得她只能把所有的外套都穿上睡觉。

sentences.en: Some nights, she ate only a piece of bread and drank weak tea.
sentences.zh: 有些晚上，她只吃一片面包、喝一点淡茶。

sentences.en: But she never complained, because knowledge was worth any price to her.
sentences.zh: 但她从不抱怨，因为对她来说，知识值得付出任何代价。

sentences.en: She graduated at the top of her class in physics.
sentences.zh: 她以物理专业第一名的成绩毕业。

sentences.en: In Paris, she met a young scientist named Pierre Curie.
sentences.zh: 在巴黎，她遇到了年轻科学家皮埃尔·居里。

sentences.en: They discovered that they shared the same dream, and in 1895 they married.
sentences.zh: 他们发现彼此怀有同样的梦想，并于1895年结婚。

sentences.en: Together, they worked in a small, broken laboratory with a leaking roof.
sentences.zh: 他们一起在一间屋顶漏雨、破旧狭小的实验室里工作。

sentences.en: Marie chose to study the strange rays that came from a metal called uranium.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚选择研究一种名叫铀的金属发出的神秘射线。

sentences.en: These rays were invisible, but they carried surprising power.
sentences.zh: 这些射线看不见，却带着惊人的能量。

sentences.en: Other scientists had reported them, but nobody could explain them.
sentences.zh: 别的科学家曾报告过它们，但没有人能解释它们。

sentences.en: Marie's careful experiments produced clear evidence that something entirely new was hiding inside the rock.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚细致的实验提供了清晰的证据：岩石里藏着某种全新的东西。

sentences.en: In 1898, she discovered not one new element but two.
sentences.zh: 1898年，她发现的新元素不是一种，而是两种。

sentences.en: She named the first one polonium, after her home country, Poland.
sentences.zh: 她把第一种以祖国波兰命名为"钋"。

sentences.en: The second one, which glowed faintly in the dark, she called radium.
sentences.zh: 第二种元素在黑暗中发出微光，她称之为"镭"。

sentences.en: The work of obtaining pure radium was almost impossible.
sentences.zh: 提取纯镭的工作近乎不可能完成。

sentences.en: To obtain even a tiny spoonful, she and Pierre had to boil tons of dark rock in huge pots, year after year.
sentences.zh: 为了提取哪怕一小勺，她和皮埃尔年复一年地用大锅熬煮成吨的黑色矿石。

sentences.en: The laboratory had no protection of any kind, because nobody yet knew the rays were dangerous.
sentences.zh: 实验室里没有任何防护，因为当时还没有人知道那些射线是有害的。

sentences.en: In 1903, Marie, Pierre, and the scientist Henri Becquerel shared the Nobel Prize in Physics.
sentences.zh: 1903年，玛丽亚、皮埃尔与科学家亨利·贝克勒尔共同获得诺贝尔物理学奖。

sentences.en: It was the first Nobel Prize ever given to a woman.
sentences.zh: 那是史上第一次有女性获得诺贝尔奖。

sentences.en: Only three years later, in 1906, Pierre was killed in a street accident.
sentences.zh: 仅仅三年后的1906年，皮埃尔在一场街头事故中丧生。

sentences.en: The sadness nearly destroyed Marie, but she refused to stop working.
sentences.zh: 悲痛几乎击垮了玛丽亚，但她拒绝停止工作。

sentences.en: She took over Pierre's position and became the first female professor at the Sorbonne.
sentences.zh: 她接过了皮埃尔的职位，成为索邦大学第一位女教授。

sentences.en: In 1911, she won a second Nobel Prize, this time in chemistry.
sentences.zh: 1911年，她第二次获得诺贝尔奖，这次是化学奖。

sentences.en: She was the first person in history to win two Nobel Prizes.
sentences.zh: 她是历史上第一位两次获得诺贝尔奖的人。

sentences.en: During the First World War, Marie saw that army doctors needed a way to look inside the bodies of injured soldiers.
sentences.zh: 第一次世界大战期间，玛丽亚看到军医们需要一种查看伤员身体内部的办法。

sentences.en: So she invented small, portable X-ray machines that could travel to the front lines.
sentences.zh: 于是她发明了可以运往前线的小型便携式X光机。

sentences.en: The soldiers called these little machines "petites Curies" — little Curies.
sentences.zh: 士兵们称这些小机器为"小居里"。

sentences.en: She trained her teenage daughter Irene and about a hundred and fifty other women to operate them.
sentences.zh: 她训练自己十几岁的女儿伊蕾娜和大约一百五十名女性学会操作。

sentences.en: Over a million soldiers were examined with these machines before the war ended.
sentences.zh: 战争结束前，超过一百万名士兵借助这些机器接受了检查。

sentences.en: Marie never protected herself from the rays she loved.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚从未防护过她所热爱的那些射线。

sentences.en: After years of radiation, her health was slowly destroyed.
sentences.zh: 多年的辐射慢慢摧毁了她的健康。

sentences.en: She died in 1934, from a blood disease caused by her own work.
sentences.zh: 1934年，她死于由自己的工作引发的血液疾病。

sentences.en: Even today, her notebooks are kept in lead boxes in a Paris library.
sentences.zh: 直到今天，她的笔记本仍存放在巴黎一家图书馆的铅盒里。

sentences.en: They are still radioactive, so scientists who wish to read them must sign a promise to protect themselves.
sentences.zh: 它们仍带有放射性，想查阅的科学家必须签署防护承诺书。

sentences.en: Marie Curie's life teaches a simple lesson.
sentences.zh: 玛丽·居里的一生教给我们一个朴素的道理。

sentences.en: Real courage is not shouting loudly; it is the ability to endure hardship quietly and keep working.
sentences.zh: 真正的勇气不是高声呐喊，而是默默忍受困苦、坚持工作的能力。

sentences.en: She once said, "Nothing in life is to be feared; it is only to be understood."
sentences.zh: 她曾说："生活中没有什么可畏惧的，它只需要被理解。"

sentences.en: Because of her, science learned to see the invisible, and girls everywhere learned to dream bigger.
sentences.zh: 因为她，科学学会了看见不可见之物，世界各地的女孩也学会了做更大的梦。

questions.q: Why couldn't Maria attend university in Poland?
options: She failed the entrance exams.
Women were not permitted to attend university there at that time.
Her family forbade her to study.
Warsaw had no universities at all.
questions.explain: "women were not permitted to attend university there" —— 当时的波兰不允许女性上大学。

questions.q: How did Maria help her sister Bronya first?
options: She worked as a governess for six years to pay for Bronya's education in Paris.
She lent her radium samples.
She taught her chemistry at home.
She wrote her university essays for her.
questions.explain: 姐妹间的秘密计划：玛丽亚先打工六年供姐姐读书，姐姐再回报她。

questions.q: Why did Marie name the first element she discovered "polonium"?
options: Because it glowed in the dark.
After her home country, Poland.
After her husband, Pierre.
After her sister, Bronya.
questions.explain: "She named the first one polonium, after her home country, Poland" —— 以祖国波兰命名。

questions.q: Why are Marie Curie's notebooks kept in lead boxes today?
options: They are extremely old and valuable.
They are still radioactive from her experiments.
They contain secret military formulas.
The library is too small for shelves.
questions.explain: 笔记至今仍有放射性，查阅者须签署防护承诺 —— 这是她一生工作的代价。

questions.q: According to the passage, what is real courage?
options: Shouting loudly when facing problems.
Enduring hardship quietly and continuing to work.
Winning two Nobel Prizes.
Refusing to sleep or eat.
questions.explain: 结尾点题："the ability to endure hardship quietly and keep working"。

title: How Bees Help Our Dinner

sentences.en: When you bite into a sweet apple, you probably do not think about bees.
sentences.zh: 当你咬下一口甜甜的苹果时，你大概不会想到蜜蜂。

sentences.en: But without bees and other pollinators, that apple could not exist at all.
sentences.zh: 但如果没有蜜蜂和其他传粉者，那只苹果根本不会存在。

sentences.en: Scientists say that about one third of the food we eat depends on animal pollinators.
sentences.zh: 科学家说，我们吃的食物大约有三分之一依赖动物传粉。

sentences.en: Apples, watermelons, cherries, tomatoes, and almonds all need help from small creatures.
sentences.zh: 苹果、西瓜、樱桃、番茄和杏仁，都离不开小动物们的帮忙。

sentences.en: To understand why, you need a little basic biology.
sentences.zh: 要弄清原因，你需要一点基础的生物学知识。

sentences.en: A flower is not only beautiful; it is a machine for making seeds.
sentences.zh: 花不仅美丽，它还是一台制造种子的机器。

sentences.en: To make seeds, pollen must travel from one flower to another.
sentences.zh: 要结出种子，花粉必须从一朵花传到另一朵花。

sentences.en: This process is called pollination.
sentences.zh: 这个过程叫做授粉。

sentences.en: Some plants, like corn and wheat, use the wind to transfer their pollen.
sentences.zh: 有些植物，比如玉米和小麦，靠风来传送花粉。

sentences.en: For them, the wind is a free transport service.
sentences.zh: 对它们来说，风就是免费的运输服务。

sentences.en: But many fruit trees and vegetables depend on insects instead.
sentences.zh: 但许多果树和蔬菜依靠的却是昆虫。

sentences.en: This is where the bee comes in.
sentences.zh: 这就轮到蜜蜂登场了。

sentences.en: A bee does not intend to help the flowers; it is only looking for food.
sentences.zh: 蜜蜂并不是有意帮助花朵，它只是在寻找食物。

sentences.en: It lands on a flower and drinks the sweet liquid called nectar.
sentences.zh: 它落在花上，吸食那种叫花蜜的甜液。

sentences.en: It also collects pollen, a yellow powder full of protein, to feed its young at home.
sentences.zh: 它还采集花粉——一种富含蛋白质的黄色粉末——带回家喂幼虫。

sentences.en: A bee's body is covered with tiny, branched hairs.
sentences.zh: 蜜蜂的身体覆盖着细小的分支绒毛。

sentences.en: As it moves inside the flower, pollen sticks to the hairs like dust to a sweater.
sentences.zh: 它在花里爬动时，花粉便粘在绒毛上，就像灰尘粘在毛衣上。

sentences.en: When the bee flies to the next flower, some of the pollen rubs off.
sentences.zh: 当蜜蜂飞到下一朵花时，一部分花粉就被蹭了下来。

sentences.en: If that pollen lands on exactly the right part of the new flower, seeds begin to form.
sentences.zh: 如果这些花粉恰好落在新花的正确部位，种子就开始形成。

sentences.en: In this way, a bee transfers pollen from flower to flower all day long.
sentences.zh: 就这样，蜜蜂整日把花粉从一朵花搬到另一朵花。

sentences.en: A single honeybee may visit hundreds of flowers in one day.
sentences.zh: 一只蜜蜂一天可以造访数百朵花。

sentences.en: And a healthy colony may contain more than fifty thousand workers.
sentences.zh: 而一个健康的蜂群可以拥有五万多名"工人"。

sentences.en: Numbers like these make bees the most important pollinators on earth.
sentences.zh: 这样的数量使蜜蜂成为地球上最重要的传粉者。

sentences.en: Bees do even more than carry pollen.
sentences.zh: 蜜蜂做的还不止搬运花粉。

sentences.en: Inside the hive, they share information in an amazing way.
sentences.zh: 在蜂巢里，它们以一种惊人的方式共享信息。

sentences.en: When a bee finds a rich field of flowers, it returns home and performs a dance.
sentences.zh: 当一只蜜蜂找到一片花田，它会飞回巢里跳一支舞。

sentences.en: The direction and the length of the dance report the location and distance of the food.
sentences.zh: 舞蹈的方向和时长，报告的就是食物的位置和距离。

sentences.en: Other bees watch the dance and then fly straight to the flowers.
sentences.zh: 其他蜜蜂看完舞蹈，便直奔花田而去。

sentences.en: It is as if the hive had its own tiny newspaper.
sentences.zh: 这就好比蜂群拥有自己的一份微型报纸。

sentences.en: Karl von Frisch, the scientist who first described this dance, won a Nobel Prize for the discovery in 1973.
sentences.zh: 最早描述这种舞蹈的科学家卡尔·冯·弗里施，因此项发现于1973年获得诺贝尔奖。

sentences.en: Sadly, the world of bees is facing serious problems.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，蜜蜂的世界正面临严峻的问题。

sentences.en: In many countries, beekeepers have reported the sudden loss of whole colonies.
sentences.zh: 在许多国家，养蜂人报告过整群蜜蜂突然消失的怪事。

sentences.en: Scientists believe there is no single cause.
sentences.zh: 科学家们认为原因并不单一。

sentences.en: New diseases, some farm chemicals, and the loss of wild flowers often occur together.
sentences.zh: 新病害、某些农用化学品和野花的消失常常同时出现。

sentences.en: When one problem appears, the others quickly make it worse.
sentences.zh: 一个问题出现时，其他问题会迅速令其恶化。

sentences.en: If bees disappeared, our dinner table would change completely.
sentences.zh: 如果蜜蜂消失，我们的餐桌将彻底改变。

sentences.en: A world without bees would still have corn and rice, which are wind-pollinated.
sentences.zh: 没有蜜蜂的世界仍会有靠风传粉的玉米和水稻。

sentences.en: But apples and cherries would become rare and expensive.
sentences.zh: 但苹果和樱桃将变得稀有而昂贵。

sentences.en: Fortunately, everyone can do something to help.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，每个人都能帮上忙。

sentences.en: Planting flowers on a balcony or in a school garden gives city bees the food they need.
sentences.zh: 在阳台或校园花园里种花，就能给城里的蜜蜂提供所需的食物。

sentences.en: Choosing not to spray chemicals while flowers are blooming also protects them.
sentences.zh: 在开花期不喷洒化学药剂，同样能保护它们。

sentences.en: Even leaving a small corner of the garden wild can provide a home for wild bees.
sentences.zh: 哪怕留一小块园地任其荒长，也能给野生蜜蜂提供家园。

sentences.en: Bees work quietly and never ask for thanks.
sentences.zh: 蜜蜂默默工作，从不求人感谢。

sentences.en: But our fruit, our seeds, and the whole natural system depend on them.
sentences.zh: 但我们的水果、种子乃至整个自然系统都依赖于它们。

sentences.en: The next time you eat a sweet apple, remember the small, fuzzy worker that made it possible.
sentences.zh: 下次吃甜苹果时，请记得那个让它成为可能的小小毛茸茸工人。

questions.q: About how much of the food we eat depends on animal pollinators?
options: Almost none.
About one third.
About two thirds.
Nearly everything.
questions.explain: "about one third of the food we eat depends on animal pollinators" —— 约三分之一。

questions.q: Why does pollen stick to a bee's body?
options: Its body is covered with tiny branched hairs.
Pollen is slightly magnetic.
Bees carry it in their mouths.
Flowers glue it on with nectar.
questions.explain: "A bee's body is covered with tiny, branched hairs"，花粉像灰尘粘毛衣一样粘上去。

questions.q: What does a bee's dance inside the hive do?
options: It asks the queen for food.
It reports the location and distance of flowers.
It warns the colony of rain.
It celebrates the end of the day.
questions.explain: 舞蹈的方向和时长 "report the location and distance of the food"。

questions.q: Which of these would probably become rare if bees disappeared?
options: Corn and rice.
Wheat and oats.
Apples and cherries.
Grass and bamboo.
questions.explain: 玉米水稻靠风传粉仍会存在，而苹果樱桃等依赖昆虫，会变得"rare and expensive"。

questions.q: According to the passage, what can people do to help bees?
options: Keep balconies completely empty.
Plant flowers and avoid spraying chemicals when flowers bloom.
Feed bees cooked rice.
Cut down trees around the city.
questions.explain: 结尾的三条建议：种花、开花期不喷药、留小块野地。

title: The Secret Life of Word Roots

sentences.en: If you could see through the cover of an English dictionary, you would notice something surprising.
sentences.zh: 如果你能透过英语词典的封面看进去，你会注意到一件奇怪的事。

sentences.en: English words are not strangers to each other.
sentences.zh: 英语单词之间并非毫不相干的陌生人。

sentences.en: Thousands of them belong to a small number of families, like cousins who share the same grandfather.
sentences.zh: 成千上万的词属于少数几个家族，就像共有一位祖父的堂表兄弟姐妹。

sentences.en: The head of each family is not a word at all, but a root: a short piece of ancient Latin that carries one basic meaning.
sentences.zh: 每个家族的族长根本不是一个词，而是一个词根：一小段承载着单一基本含义的古老拉丁文。

sentences.en: Consider the root spect, which comes from the Latin word meaning "to look".
sentences.zh: 以词根 spect 为例，它来自拉丁语，意思是"看"。

sentences.en: Add different beginnings and endings, and a whole family of words appears.
sentences.zh: 加上不同的前缀和后缀，整整一个单词家族便浮现出来。

sentences.en: When you inspect something, you look into it closely.
sentences.zh: 当你 inspect（检查）某物时，你是往里仔细地看。

sentences.en: A spectator is a person who looks at a game or a show.
sentences.zh: spectator（观众）就是观看比赛或演出的人。

sentences.en: When you respect someone, you look up to them, again and again.
sentences.zh: 当你 respect（尊敬）某人时，你是一再地抬头仰望他们。

sentences.en: In retrospect means looking back at the past.
sentences.zh: in retrospect 意为回顾过去。

sentences.en: And a prospect is a possible future that you look forward to.
sentences.zh: 而 prospect（前景）是你向前眺望的那个可能的未来。

sentences.en: One root, ten doors.
sentences.zh: 一个词根，十扇门。

sentences.en: Learn one key, and a whole corridor opens.
sentences.zh: 掌握一把钥匙，整条走廊便向你敞开。

sentences.en: Now look at struct, which means "to build".
sentences.zh: 再看 struct，它的意思是"建造"。

sentences.en: To construct a bridge is to build it, piece by piece.
sentences.zh: construct（建造）一座桥，就是把它一块一块地建起来。

sentences.en: A structure is anything that has been built, from a bird's nest to a skyscraper.
sentences.zh: structure（结构、建筑物）指任何被建造出来的东西，从鸟窝到摩天大楼。

sentences.en: To instruct a student is, in a beautiful sense, to build knowledge inside them.
sentences.zh: instruct（教导）一个学生，从某种美妙的意义上说，是在他心里建造知识。

sentences.en: And destroy simply means to un-build something: the Latin prefix de- takes the building apart.
sentences.zh: 而 destroy（摧毁）的意思就是"拆掉"：拉丁前缀 de- 把建筑物拆散。

sentences.en: Port means "to carry".
sentences.zh: port 的意思是"携带、搬运"。

sentences.en: It hides inside transport (to carry across), import (to carry into a country), and export (to carry out).
sentences.zh: 它藏在 transport（运输，横着搬）、import（进口，搬进来）和 export（出口，搬出去）里面。

sentences.en: A portable radio is light enough to be carried by one hand.
sentences.zh: portable 收音机轻到一只手就能拎走。

sentences.en: A porter is a person whose whole job is to carry travelers' bags.
sentences.zh: porter（搬运工）就是以替旅客搬行李为业的人。

sentences.en: Even the word report contains this root: a report carries information back to someone.
sentences.zh: 连 report 这个词里也藏着它：report（报告）就是把信息搬回去交给别人。

sentences.en: And opportunity? Sailors once used it for a favorable wind that carried a ship safely toward port.
sentences.zh: 那 opportunity 呢？水手们曾用它指那阵把船稳稳送向港口的顺风。

sentences.en: The root ject means "to throw".
sentences.zh: 词根 ject 的意思是"扔、投掷"。

sentences.en: To reject a plan is to throw it back.
sentences.zh: reject（拒绝）一个计划，就是把它扔回去。

sentences.en: To eject something is to throw it out.
sentences.zh: eject（弹出、驱逐）就是把它扔出去。

sentences.en: To inject medicine is to throw it into the body through a needle.
sentences.zh: inject（注射）就是通过针头把药液掷入体内。

sentences.en: And when you object to an idea, you throw your own opinion in its way.
sentences.zh: 而当你 object（反对）一个观点时，你是把自己的意见拦在了它的去路上。

sentences.en: A project, such as a school science project, is literally a plan thrown forward into the future.
sentences.zh: project（项目，如学校的科学项目），字面意思就是投向未来的一份计划。

sentences.en: What is truly amazing is where these roots come from.
sentences.zh: 更令人惊叹的是这些词根的来历。

sentences.en: More than two thousand years ago, Roman soldiers, merchants, and teachers spread Latin across Europe.
sentences.zh: 两千多年前，罗马的士兵、商人和教师把拉丁语传遍了欧洲。

sentences.en: After the Roman Empire fell, Latin did not die; it simply changed its clothes.
sentences.zh: 罗马帝国衰亡后，拉丁语并没有死，它只是换了一身衣裳。

sentences.en: It transformed slowly into French, Italian, Spanish, and the other Romance languages.
sentences.zh: 它慢慢 transformed（转变）为法语、意大利语、西班牙语等罗曼语族语言。

sentences.en: In 1066, French-speaking rulers arrived in England, and their vocabulary was imported into English like goods into a harbor.
sentences.zh: 1066年，讲法语的统治者来到英格兰，他们的词汇像进港的货物一样被 imported（引入）英语。

sentences.en: That is why English often has two words for one idea: a plain one like "begin" beside a Latin-flavored one like "commence".
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么英语常为一个意思备两个词：朴素的 begin，与带着拉丁味的 commence。

sentences.en: Roots are not only Latin, of course; Greek also donated generously.
sentences.zh: 词根当然不只来自拉丁语，希腊语也十分慷慨。

sentences.en: Bio means "life", so biology is the study of living things.
sentences.zh: bio 意为"生命"，所以 biology 是研究生物的学问。

sentences.en: Graph means "to write", so a photograph is "light writing" and a biography is "life writing".
sentences.zh: graph 意为"写"，所以 photograph 是"光的书写"，biography 是"人生的书写"。

sentences.en: Phon means "sound": a telephone carries "far sound", and a symphony puts "sounds together".
sentences.zh: phon 意为"声音"：telephone 传送"远方的声音"，symphony 则把"声音放在一起"。

sentences.en: Once you begin to notice roots, you see them everywhere, like a hidden pattern printed under the surface of the language.
sentences.zh: 一旦你开始留意词根，你会发现它们无处不在，像印在语言表层之下的一幅隐藏图案。

sentences.en: Even scientists use the trick: when doctors invent a new medical term, they usually construct it from these same roots, like bricks.
sentences.zh: 连科学家都用这一招：医生发明新医学术语时，通常也用这些词根像砌砖一样 construct 出来。

sentences.en: For a Chinese student, this is very good news.
sentences.zh: 对中国学生来说，这是个天大的好消息。

sentences.en: You do not need to memorize ten thousand words one by one.
sentences.zh: 你不必一个一个地死记一万个单词。

sentences.en: You need perhaps two hundred roots, and then many new words will introduce themselves to you, already half familiar.
sentences.zh: 你也许只需两百个词根，然后许多生词便会主动向你自我介绍——你已经对它们眼熟了。

sentences.en: Of course, roots cannot predict every meaning; languages are full of surprises and stubborn exceptions.
sentences.zh: 当然，词根不能 predict（预测）每个词义；语言里满是意外和固执的例外。

sentences.en: But they can always offer a reliable first guess, and confidence is half the battle in reading.
sentences.zh: 但它们总能给出靠谱的第一猜测，而信心正是阅读这场战役的一半胜算。

sentences.en: So the next time you meet a long, frightening English word, do not panic.
sentences.zh: 所以下次遇到一个又长又吓人的英语单词时，别慌。

sentences.en: Inspect it calmly, look for a familiar root in the middle, and let the word tell you its own history.
sentences.zh: 冷静地 inspect（审视）它，在词中寻找那个熟悉的词根，让这个词亲口讲出自己的历史。

sentences.en: In retrospect, you may wonder why English ever looked so difficult.
sentences.zh: 回头看（in retrospect），你也许会奇怪：英语当初怎么会显得那么难。

questions.q: What does the root "spect" mean?
options: To build.
To look.
To carry.
To throw.
questions.explain: "the root spect, which comes from the Latin word meaning 'to look'" —— spect = 看。

questions.q: The word "report" contains the root "port". What does this tell us about its original meaning?
options: It carries information back to someone.
It looks carefully at facts.
It builds a strong argument.
It throws away old news.
questions.explain: "a report carries information back to someone" —— 报告就是把信息"搬"回去。

questions.q: Why does English often have two words for one idea, like "begin" and "commence"?
options: English speakers simply love synonyms.
French-speaking rulers brought many Latin-based words to England in 1066.
Scientists created the longer words.
Early dictionaries had printing errors.
questions.explain: 1066年法语统治者的词汇"像进港货物一样"融入英语，形成本族词与拉丁味词并存的格局。

questions.q: What does the root "graph" mean in words like photograph and biography?
options: Sound.
Life.
To write.
Light.
questions.explain: "Graph means 'to write'" —— photograph 是"光的书写"，biography 是"人生的书写"。

questions.q: According to the passage, how do word roots help learners most?
options: They make grammar unnecessary.
They give a reliable first guess at new words' meanings.
They improve pronunciation automatically.
They explain the history of Chinese characters.
questions.explain: 结尾：词根虽不能 predict 每个词义，但总能给出"reliable first guess"，信心是阅读制胜的一半。

title: The Silk Road: The World's First Great Highway

sentences.en: Two thousand years ago, there were no trains, no trucks, and no planes.
sentences.zh: 两千年前，没有火车，没有卡车，也没有飞机。

sentences.en: If you wanted to move a heavy load across a continent, you needed a camel.
sentences.zh: 想把沉重的货物运过大陆，你需要一头骆驼。

sentences.en: From the ancient Chinese capital of Chang'an — today's Xi'an — caravans set off westward, loaded with goods.
sentences.zh: 从古代中国首都长安（今西安）出发，满载货物的驼队一路向西。

sentences.en: They crossed burning deserts, climbed icy mountain passes, and followed narrow valleys for thousands of kilometers.
sentences.zh: 它们穿越灼热的沙漠，翻过冰雪的山口，沿着狭长的山谷跋涉数千公里。

sentences.en: Their final stops were the great markets of Central Asia, Persia, and even distant Rome.
sentences.zh: 它们的终点是中亚、波斯乃至遥远罗马的大市场。

sentences.en: Later, people gave this huge network of routes a romantic name: the Silk Road.
sentences.zh: 后来，人们给这张庞大的路线网起了一个浪漫的名字：丝绸之路。

sentences.en: The German scholar Ferdinand von Richthofen first used the term in 1877.
sentences.zh: 1877年，德国学者李希霍芬首次使用了这个名称。

sentences.en: Why silk?
sentences.zh: 为什么是丝绸？

sentences.en: Among all the products China exported to the West, silk was the most famous.
sentences.zh: 在中国出口到西方的所有货物中，丝绸最负盛名。

sentences.en: It was light, beautiful, and worth its weight in gold.
sentences.zh: 它轻盈、华美，一磅丝绸值一磅黄金。

sentences.en: A camel could carry a fortune of silk on its back and still walk easily through soft sand.
sentences.zh: 骆驼背上驮着一笔丝绸财富，仍能轻松走过松软的沙丘。

sentences.en: In fact, silk was so light and portable that traders sometimes used it like money itself.
sentences.zh: 事实上，丝绸轻便易携（portable）到商人有时直接把它当钱用。

sentences.en: But silk was only the beginning.
sentences.zh: 但丝绸只是开始。

sentences.en: Chinese merchants also exported fine porcelain, tea, paper, and bronze mirrors.
sentences.zh: 中国商人还出口精美的瓷器、茶叶、纸张和铜镜。

sentences.en: On the return journey, the caravans imported horses from Central Asia, glass from the Mediterranean, and spices, gems, and wool from many lands.
sentences.zh: 回程时，驼队从中亚进口好马，从地中海进口玻璃，还进口各国的香料、宝石和毛料。

sentences.en: Trade is a two-way street, and so was the Silk Road.
sentences.zh: 贸易是双向的街道，丝绸之路亦然。

sentences.en: The story of the road really begins with a brave traveler named Zhang Qian.
sentences.zh: 这条路的故事真正始于一位勇敢的旅行者——张骞。

sentences.en: In 138 BC, Emperor Wu of Han sent him west to find allies against the enemies of the north.
sentences.zh: 公元前138年，汉武帝派他西行，去联络北方大敌的对手结盟。

sentences.en: Zhang Qian was captured by those enemies and held for ten long years, but he never gave up his mission.
sentences.zh: 张骞被敌人俘获，扣留了整整十年，但他始终没有放弃使命。

sentences.en: When he finally returned to Chang'an, he brought no allies at all.
sentences.zh: 当他终于回到长安时，一个盟友也没带来。

sentences.en: Instead, he brought something more valuable: detailed knowledge of the western lands, recorded in careful reports for the emperor.
sentences.zh: 他带回的却是更有价值的东西：关于西域的详尽见闻，被仔细记录成呈给皇帝的报告。

sentences.en: His journey opened the eyes of China to a wider world.
sentences.zh: 他的旅程让中国第一次睁眼看见了更辽阔的世界。

sentences.en: Within a generation, caravans were following his route in both directions.
sentences.zh: 不出一代人的时间，驼队便沿着他的路线双向往来。

sentences.en: Goods were not the only things that traveled; ideas rode the camels too.
sentences.zh: 在路上行走的不止货物，思想也骑着骆驼旅行。

sentences.en: Buddhism, for example, traveled from India along these routes into China.
sentences.zh: 例如，佛教便沿着这些路线从印度传入中国。

sentences.en: Paper-making technology moved slowly westward and transformed how the whole world wrote and read.
sentences.zh: 造纸术缓缓西传，transformed（改变）了全世界的书写与阅读方式。

sentences.en: Astronomy, mathematics, and medicine flowed in both directions along the road.
sentences.zh: 天文、数学和医药知识也沿着这条路双向流动。

sentences.en: Even foods were exchanged: grapes, walnuts, and sesame came to China from the west, while pears and peaches traveled the other way.
sentences.zh: 连食物也互通有无：葡萄、核桃、芝麻从西域来到中国，梨和桃则去了西方。

sentences.en: Every exchange of goods was also a transfer of culture.
sentences.zh: 每一次货物交换，也是一次文化的 transfer（传递）。

sentences.en: Life on the road, however, was far from romantic.
sentences.zh: 然而，路上的生活一点也不浪漫。

sentences.en: The Taklamakan Desert was so merciless that local people called it the place of no return.
sentences.zh: 塔克拉玛干沙漠残酷无情，当地人称之为"有去无回之地"。

sentences.en: Travelers endured burning days, freezing nights, and sandstorms that could bury a whole caravan.
sentences.zh: 旅行者 endured（忍受）着白天的酷热、夜里的严寒，以及足以埋没整支驼队的沙暴。

sentences.en: Robbers hid in the mountain passes, watching for slow, heavily loaded camels.
sentences.zh: 强盗们埋伏在山口，盯上那些走得慢、驮得沉的骆驼。

sentences.en: That is why merchants traveled together and hired guards to support and protect their caravans.
sentences.zh: 所以商人们结伴而行，雇人 support（支援）和保护驼队。

sentences.en: The oasis towns along the way became rich and famous, because in the desert, water is life.
sentences.zh: 沿途的绿洲城镇变得富有而闻名，因为在沙漠里，水就是命。

sentences.en: Dunhuang, at the edge of the Gobi, grew into one of the greatest cities of the road.
sentences.zh: 戈壁边缘的敦煌，成长为丝路上最伟大的城市之一。

sentences.en: Its Buddhist cave temples, filled with wall paintings, still amaze visitors today.
sentences.zh: 它那绘满壁画的佛教石窟，至今仍令游客惊叹。

sentences.en: Money also had to travel, but tons of bronze coins were too heavy for the mountains.
sentences.zh: 钱也需要流通，可成吨的铜钱太重，翻不动大山。

sentences.en: So along the road, silk itself became a kind of currency, and traders from many countries learned to bargain in a mixture of languages.
sentences.zh: 于是在丝路上，丝绸本身成了某种 currency（货币），各国商人学会了用混杂的语言讨价还价。

sentences.en: Today, camels no longer carry silk across the sands.
sentences.zh: 今天，骆驼不再驮着丝绸穿越沙海。

sentences.en: But the road never truly died.
sentences.zh: 但这条路从未真正消亡。

sentences.en: Freight trains now transport goods between China and Europe in days instead of months.
sentences.zh: 如今货运列车往来于中欧之间，transport（运输）货物只需数日而非数月。

sentences.en: Tourists walk the old routes to stand where the caravans once stood.
sentences.zh: 游客们重走古道，站在驼队曾经停驻的地方。

sentences.en: The Silk Road teaches a lesson that never gets old.
sentences.zh: 丝绸之路教给我们一个永不过时的道理。

sentences.en: When civilizations trade and talk, everybody gains more than gold: they gain new ideas, new foods, and new ways of seeing the world.
sentences.zh: 当文明之间彼此贸易、彼此交谈，人人得到的都远胜黄金：新的思想、新的食物、新的看世界的方式。

sentences.en: Every long journey begins with a single step, and every good exchange begins with an open door.
sentences.zh: 千里之行始于足下，而每一场美好的交流，始于一扇敞开的门。

questions.q: Why was silk ideal for trade across such long distances?
options: It was heavy and hard to damage.
It was light, portable, and worth a great deal.
Camels would only carry silk.
It could be eaten in emergencies.
questions.explain: 丝绸"light and portable"且贵比黄金，骆驼驮上一笔财富也能轻松走过软沙。

questions.q: What was Zhang Qian's original mission in 138 BC?
options: To sell silk to Rome.
To find allies against the enemies of the north.
To build a road to Persia.
To bring back grape seeds.
questions.explain: "Emperor Wu of Han sent him west to find allies against the enemies of the north"。

questions.q: What did Zhang Qian bring back that was 'more valuable than allies'?
options: Gold and silver from Persia.
Detailed knowledge of the western lands, recorded in careful reports.
A herd of fine horses.
Maps drawn in Rome.
questions.explain: 他没有带回盟友，却带回了关于西域的详尽见闻和写给皇帝的报告，让中国睁眼看世界。

questions.q: Which of the following statements is correct according to the passage?
options: Buddhism and grapes traveled into China, while paper-making moved westward.
Buddhism traveled from China to India.
Paper-making was imported into China from Rome.
Silk traveled eastward toward Chang'an.
questions.explain: 佛教、葡萄等自西传入中国，造纸术则西传并改变了世界的书写方式。

questions.q: What made journeys on the Silk Road so dangerous?
options: Desert heat, sandstorms, and robbers in the mountain passes.
Too many tourists on the route.
The extremely heavy silk.
High taxes at Chang'an's city gate.
questions.explain: 文中列举：塔克拉玛干的酷热沙暴、山口的强盗，所以商队结伴并雇护卫。

title: Lost in the Cloud Forest

sentences.en: The cloud forest of Yunnan is one of the wettest, greenest places on earth.
sentences.zh: 云南的云雾森林是地球上最潮湿、最翠绿的地方之一。

sentences.en: Clouds walk through the treetops like quiet white animals.
sentences.zh: 云朵像安静的白色动物，在树冠间穿行。

sentences.en: Last April, our class went there on a three-day science trip.
sentences.zh: 去年四月，我们班去那里进行为期三天的科考旅行。

sentences.en: Our guide was Mr. Zhou, a quiet man who had walked these mountains for twenty years.
sentences.zh: 向导是周老师，一个在山里走了二十年的沉默寡言的人。

sentences.en: On the first morning, he gave us three rules.
sentences.zh: 第一天早上，他给我们立了三条规矩。

sentences.en: "Rule one: never leave the group. Rule two: take nothing but photographs. Rule three: if you are lost, stay where you are."
sentences.zh: "规矩一：绝不离队。规矩二：只带走照片。规矩三：迷路了，原地不动。"

sentences.en: On the second afternoon, the trouble began with a bird.
sentences.zh: 第二天下午，麻烦从一只鸟开始。

sentences.en: Tang Rui, my best friend, heard a strange, liquid whistle from the trees.
sentences.zh: 我的好友唐锐听到树上传来一声流水般婉转的哨音。

sentences.en: A bird with shining blue feathers was hopping along a branch, carrying something red in its beak.
sentences.zh: 一只长着闪亮蓝色羽毛的鸟正沿着树枝跳跃，嘴里叼着红色的东西。

sentences.en: I raised my camera and stepped off the path to photograph it.
sentences.zh: 我举起相机，离开小路去拍它。

sentences.en: Tang Rui followed me, whispering, "Be quiet, be quiet."
sentences.zh: 唐锐跟着我，压低声音说："别出声，别出声。"

sentences.en: The bird led us around one bend after another for about ten minutes.
sentences.zh: 那只鸟带着我们拐过一道又一道弯，走了大约十分钟。

sentences.en: Then it flew up over the canopy and vanished into the mist.
sentences.zh: 然后它振翅飞过树冠，消失在雾气里。

sentences.en: And when we turned around, the path was gone.
sentences.zh: 当我们回过头时，小路不见了。
